footer.aboutTitle: About This Harvard Entrance Exam Quiz
footer.aboutText: This is a fun Harvard-style reasoning quiz built around quick logic, number patterns, word clues, probability, and everyday brain teasers. It is for entertainment and self-challenge only. It is not an official Harvard University exam, admissions test, IQ test, academic assessment, or educational credential.

stageGroups.title: Warm-Up Logic
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. The next round adds a little more pressure with probability, analogies, and sharper patterns.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
Which word does not belong: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Orange?
If today is Tuesday, what day will it be in 10 days?
If all Bloops are Razzies, and all Razzies are Lazzies, what must be true?
Which shape has the fewest sides: square, pentagon, hexagon, triangle?
If CAT becomes DBU, what does DOG become?
Which number is even: 13, 19, 22, 27?
Three friends each shake hands with every other friend once. How many handshakes occur?
Which letter comes next: B, D, F, H, ?
If a train leaves at 1:20 and arrives at 2:05, how long was the trip?

stageGroups.title: Brain Teasers
stageGroups.encouragement: Good. The final admissions round turns up the challenge with probability, cubes, vocabulary, and careful logic.

questions.prompt: Which number is missing: 2, 5, 10, 17, ?
Ana is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Cara. Who is tallest?
Which pair matches pen : write?
Which number completes the pattern: 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
A basket contains 5 red balls and 3 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
A farmer has 20 cows. Half are brown. How many are brown?
Which word best completes: doctor : hospital :: teacher : ?
Two notebooks cost £8. How much do five notebooks cost?
Which number completes: 1, 8, 27, 64, ?
A meeting starts at 10:15 and ends at 11:05. How long does it last?
Which number comes next: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
A clock shows 3:00. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
If some artists are writers, and all writers are readers, what must be true?
Which is larger: one-half or two-fifths?
If two people can paint two walls in two hours, how many walls can four people paint in two hours?
You flip a fair coin three times. What is the probability of getting heads all three times?
A cube is painted on all sides and cut into 27 equal cubes. How many small cubes have paint on exactly two faces?
Which number comes next: 6, 11, 21, 41, ?
A rectangle is 6 units long and 4 units wide. What is its area?
Three consecutive numbers add up to 72. What is the middle number?
